column2:
Following the annihilation of countless Bug hives, Terran Command has decided to focus its assets toward reactivating vital ore mines and assuring the safety of mining personnel.

An abandoned outpost amongst the mining facilities has been reclaimed and fortified. This old base will serve as the staging point from which the Mobile Infantry will mop up any remaining Arachnid colonies.
Do not lose the central base
Construct 4 HMG Turrets in the central base

column2: The Mine is operational. Command appreciates your efforts.
The Main Base has been lost. The mission's over...
Bugs made a mess of the Kwals' attempts to defend this base, we're here to do a better job of it.
The flyboys report some serious bug activity out to the East.
Our mission is to get these miners back into their holes, not to go play in the dust with Archie. We'll ice them as they come at the walls.
Organise your defences and call down some extra bodies. Keep those bugs outside the walls, Lieutenant!
Be advised, another major bug attack is coming in from the East.
Engineers, set up HMG turrets. Pronto!
I smell trouble. Get this base ready for what’s coming.

column2: Alright, that Mining Shaft is operational again.
There's three others around here that Command wants up and running ASAP.
Grab any materiel caches you can find! We need that equipment to keep the Bugs out of our base.
Use whatever materiel we have available to strengthen our base defenses!
Intelligence reports that there are Kwal Comm bases nearby, used to provide logistical support to the mines.
Command is collecting eager volunteers to operate those mines, but those bases are needed for dropship insertion.
You heard the officer. Get a scouting party together and start getting those bases back online.
We're going to need to reinforce those units in the mountains. Call in some Radio Operators to help out.
If Fleet won’t keep the skies clear then call HQ to deploy some Grinders!
Inform the Grinder crews about their targeting priorities: Hoppers get top billing, no exceptions!
